pages.text: Fourteen cuts take the mixed liquor down to single elements. A battery too short for its cut does nothing; the goggles say how many stages it wants. The number is set by how alike the pair is: samarium leaves neodymium in eight, but neodymium from praseodymium takes thirty-two.
pages.title: The fourteen cuts

pages.text: A cut does not halve its liquor: a batch comes out light and heavy as the ore carries them. Monazite is nine parts lights to one of the rest, and the clay's heavy liquor two-thirds yttrium, so europium and terbium come out a trickle.

Rare earth liquor parts into light rare earth liquor (raffinate, head end) and heavy rare earth liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 8 stages charged with P507, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 90 per cent raffinate.

Heavy rare earth liquor parts into samarium-europium-gadolinium liquor (raffinate, head end) and terbium-to-lutetium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 10 stages charged with P204, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 10 per cent raffinate.

Holmium-to-lutetium liquor parts into holmium-erbium liquor (raffinate, head end) and thulium-ytterbium-lutetium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 10 stages charged with P204, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 65 per cent raffinate.

Lanthanum-cerium liquor parts into lanthanum liquor (raffinate, head end) and cerium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 12 stages charged with P507, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 35 per cent raffinate.

Terbium-to-lutetium liquor parts into terbium-dysprosium liquor (raffinate, head end) and yttrium and late heavies liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 12 stages charged with P204, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 10 per cent raffinate.

Thulium-ytterbium-lutetium liquor parts into thulium liquor (raffinate, head end) and ytterbium-lutetium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 12 stages charged with P204, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 20 per cent raffinate.

Light rare earth liquor parts into lanthanum-cerium liquor (raffinate, head end) and didymium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 14 stages charged with P507, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 75 per cent raffinate.

Yttrium and late heavies liquor parts into yttrium liquor (raffinate, head end) and holmium-to-lutetium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 14 stages charged with naphthenic acid, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 85 per cent raffinate.

Samarium-europium-gadolinium liquor parts into samarium liquor (raffinate, head end) and europium-gadolinium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 16 stages charged with P507, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 30 per cent raffinate.

Europium-gadolinium liquor parts into europium liquor (raffinate, head end) and gadolinium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 18 stages charged with P507, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 5 per cent raffinate.

Holmium-erbium liquor parts into holmium liquor (raffinate, head end) and erbium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 20 stages charged with P507, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 25 per cent raffinate.

Terbium-dysprosium liquor parts into terbium liquor (raffinate, head end) and dysprosium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 20 stages charged with P507, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 15 per cent raffinate.

Ytterbium-lutetium liquor parts into ytterbium liquor (raffinate, head end) and lutetium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 20 stages charged with P507, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 85 per cent raffinate.

Didymium liquor parts into praseodymium liquor (raffinate, head end) and neodymium liquor (strip, tail end) in a battery of 32 stages charged with P507, stripped by hydrochloric acid. Each batch comes out 20 per cent raffinate.
